influences.name: Brahms
influences.context: one concert both moved and speechless when the quartet passionately and lyrically performed two of Bartok's quartets plus one by Brahms (an early influence on Bartok)

influences.name: Beethoven
influences.context: The opening and funereal Lento reflects young Bartok's unfulfilled love for violinist Stefi Geyer, with a turgid counterpoint that draws comparison to the fugal writing of Beethoven
